violated_contract: A projection named for recent entries of an append-only sequence must read the tail of that sequence, not its first page. Reading sequence > 0 with a fixed limit returns the oldest page for every record, so a thread past the page size never shows its newest changes.
canonical_prevention: Start the ascending read at latest_sequence minus the page size, which is exact when every append assigns sequence = latest_sequence + 1 in the same transaction, and seed a journal longer than the page in the regression test.
